statement: DualSense Bluetooth output report 0x31 carries the same 47-byte common block starting at byte 3 (after report ID, a sequence tag and a tag byte), so each LED field sits three bytes after its common offset: mute_button_led 11, valid_flag2 41, lightbar_setup 44, led_brightness 45, player_leds 46, RGB 47-49. CRC rules are claimed elsewhere.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 300-308; nondebug explorer 892-906 (sequence and 0x10 tag bytes before the common block). Bluetooth stays out of implementation scope (#164).
